scope: Independent commit-bound preparation review of the five added UX proposal, diagnostic and review artifacts. This disposition assesses truthful diagnosis, bounded proposed scope, preserved authority, acceptance and readiness. It is not an executable ECR packet review, implementation qualification, frozen task review round or workflow transition.
independence: The reviewer supplied read-only adversarial diagnosis and boundary advice before this proposal, but did not author the proposal, diagnostic files or implementation. The reviewer independently read the frozen artifacts and replayed their narrow observations; preflight advice is not authorship or execution approval. Only this new preparation disposition is written by the reviewer.
assessment: The exact candidate has one parent and adds only the five declared preparation files. Original ECR-0008 proposal, draft, HTML and preparation review remain unchanged. No product, reference, baseline, controller, backlog or approval authority is changed.

The addendum explicitly incorporates the new owner-requested folder-selection and sidebar outcomes while distinguishing them from the original identity-only proposal. Native request and new directory-selection authority are assigned to the proposed correction, not silently added to A08's immutable styling scope. F02 and the shared sidebar remedy remain in existing A08.T02 after authenticated return.

The six observations are supported by source inspection or narrow diagnostic replay. Catalog and lineage native omissions are distinct from not-ready behavior. Native setup already starts Core asynchronously when unlocked; the proposal preserves that behavior and addresses Projects' missing wait/recovery rather than falsely claiming Core never starts.

The compiled-library observation in the frozen diagnostic is accurately labeled as producer-unauthenticated. Neither it nor the browser's synthetic adapter is claimed as current-source native/Core qualification or proof of the owner's installed binary. Subsequent root-reported native rebuild evidence is outside this frozen candidate and is not used to upgrade this review's claims.

The proposed shared folder control, parent-selection plus derived-child destination, explicit Open/Create actions, cancellation preservation, stable retry identity and no-overwrite behavior are coherent with the requested removal of directory typing. A purpose-specific existing-Windows-dependency adapter retains the renderer's narrow authority and Core's final path/project validation. Real owner-window, accessibility, cancellation, lock/close, stale-result and denial proof remains mandatory before implementation closure.

Catalog recovery is explicitly separated from mutation retry. Input, native/readiness and Core failures require bounded safe messages; no raw exception fallback, fabricated catalog, implicit service readiness or automatic create/open/archive/delete replay is permitted.

The new presentation is truthfully no longer identity-only. Exact updated reference bytes and human approval are still prerequisites. Durable workflow-profile 1.5, all fourteen workflows and the original metadata-only semantic compatibility comparison remain binding; any necessary additional semantic JSON change must stop for an explicit versioned decision rather than relax the witness.

The revised estimate uses the unchanged 48-item, 194-point approved W1 baseline. Conservative refactor allocations are 3+3+5=11 points, or 5.67 percent, replacing the original proposed 3-point numerator. Existing A08 work, slice parents and separately bounded governance maintenance are not double counted. These are preparation estimates, not authority to exceed the eventual packet.

The review page provides the active Wave and prerequisite/detail links, explains retained defects and unavailable execution approval, offers local-only alternatives including Other, and requests no additional preliminary endorsement. The single-owner correction entry and authenticated return to paused A08 remain prerequisites; ordinary W1 resume and G1 are not authorized.
